data.narrative:
Asylon Robotics is a Series B stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private firms in the sector including Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, and Joby Aviation, with no public comparables available.

A stage-progression methodology was applied as the primary valuation lens. Using the $40M total raised as a baseline value proxy and applying a typical Series B to next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x, the analysis implies a valuation of $76M. The peer-median method was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; while 7 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier companies yielded fewer than the 3 datapoints required for reliable triangulation, and an all-sector median would introduce material bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $65M (low) to $87M (high), with a median of $76M. This range reflects the output of a single applicable method, which introduces material uncertainty. Key limitations include the reliance on stage-progression multiples as a proxy absent direct peer benchmarking, the private-only comp set, and lack of company-specific revenue or growth metrics in the provided data. Additional diligence on unit economics, customer concentration, and technology risk would be warranted before finalizing an investment position.
